understanding: Percent of total retail revenue (sum UnitPrice*Quantity) per media type, rounded to 2 decimals.
edge_cases: media type with an unsold track
reason: Uses price*quantity and the global total as denominator; matches hand calculation.

understanding: Average invoice Total per BillingCountry, only countries with at least 20 invoices.
reason: HAVING COUNT(*)>=20 handles the boundary correctly and averages the invoice totals.

understanding: Top 5 genres by total retail revenue (sum of price*quantity), descending, with revenue.
reason: Uses AVG instead of SUM, so revenue values and ranking are wrong.

understanding: Per country, the customer(s) with highest lifetime invoice total, with ties all listed.
expected: X: A One 10, B Two 10; Y: D Four 7
got: X A One 10; X B Two 10; Y D Four 7
reason: Aggregates per customer then compares to per-country max, keeping ties.

understanding: Tracks that appear in more than 4 distinct playlists, with name and playlist count.
edge_cases: two different tracks with the same name each in 3 playlists
reason: Groups by track Name, merging distinct tracks with the same name and producing a false positive.

understanding: Top 3 genres by average track duration in minutes (2 decimals), longest first.
reason: Divides milliseconds by 1000 (seconds) instead of 60000, so values are not minutes.

understanding: Countries with 5 or more customers, with the customer count.
reason: HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 excludes countries with exactly 5 customers.

understanding: Count of distinct tracks across all playlists named 'Music' (duplicate-named playlists).
reason: Filters by name across all matching playlists and counts distinct TrackId.

understanding: Percent change of total invoice revenue from 2024 to 2025, rounded to 2 decimals.
reason: Year extraction via strftime handles time-of-day boundaries and ignores out-of-range years.

understanding: For each Iron Maiden album, the number of tracks (album title, count).
reason: LEFT JOIN keeps empty albums with count 0 and the exact artist-name filter excludes lookalikes.
